Attack the frozen counter: can a wrong tool reach HELD? Writable: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-95/K95CriticA/` only.
# Change
1. Read `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-95/probe/probe95-c1.mjs` and `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-95/plan.md`. Build >= 6 wrong-but-plausible gates (patch copies of `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/scripts/round-gate.mjs` in scratch, using `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-95/probe/make-controls95.py` as a template; keep each beside copies of `cap-spawn.mjs`/`cap-run.mjs`) that violate the frozen rule in a way the counter might miss, e.g.: count fields after `trimEnd()` stripping a trailing `|`; dedupe malformed ids; report malformed ids only when the row has a URL; treat CRLF rows as malformed; read malformedRows only on the declared step but omit the key on the `--tracked`/fail-closed path; hardcode the fixture ids; check `split('|').length >= 13 && status ok`; skip rows whose id appears twice.
2. Score each with the counter run form; record verdict lines in `constructions.md` (construction, rule clause violated, counter verdict). A construction reaching HELD while violating the rule is a COUNTER finding (it does not change the frozen verdict; it is routed and reported).
3. Re-run the do-nothing control yourself once (tool = `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/scripts/round-gate.mjs`) and confirm UNMET for the right reason.
# Acceptance
`constructions.md` with >= 6 rows and verdicts; scratch removed.
